task.caption_snippet: Synthetic single-panel LSV benchmark chart, variant 06. Scenario: sparse marker HER LSV.
task.special_notes: Benchmark task seeded as a single-panel linear sweep voltammetry / polarization curve benchmark panel; route it through anchoring and curve extraction even if it is not LSV. Inspect the image only and do not use external source files.

x.visible_pattern: The x-axis shows evenly spaced labeled ticks at -0.7, -0.5, -0.3, -0.1, and 0.1 across the bottom border.
x.justification: Axis-fit validation selected a linear model with normalized RMSE 0.0000; log10 is incompatible with negative tick values.

y.justification: Axis-fit validation selected a linear model with normalized RMSE 0.0004; log10 is incompatible with zero and negative tick values.

unresolved_ambiguities: No explicit panel label is visible in the image; the target was identified as the only panel in this single-panel figure.

response.overlap_recovery_reason: All three main-plot curves are visible across the full sweep; the only notable ambiguity is mild tail crowding between the blue and red series, which remains separable by color and marker shape.

curves.overlap_notes: Leftmost marker is border-clipped; point was placed at the estimated marker center inside the frame. The right tail runs below the blue and red series but remains visually separable.

Leftmost square is border-clipped; the final plateau region is crowded with the red series, so connector points were kept on visible blue dashes or square centers. QA flagged a mild pairwise crowding advisory near x~971-993 px.

Leftmost triangle is border-clipped; on the high-current tail the red and blue series approach each other, but red triangle markers and red dash-dot segments remain visible. QA flagged a mild pairwise crowding advisory near x~971-993 px.

response.interpretation_notes: Three legend-mapped marker-line LSV curves were traced from the main plot area only. Overlap QA accepted all three curves with perfect per-curve hit metrics; the only residual warning is mild blue/red tail crowding around x~971-993 px.
unresolved_ambiguities: The first marker of each curve is clipped by the left plot border, so the first point is an inside-frame estimate of the marker center.
A mild blue/red tail crowding advisory remains near x~971-993 px, but the ambiguous fraction is low and both series stay separable by color and marker shape.

advisories.note: For marker-bearing curves, strong near-border fractions can indicate marker-rim or frame-lock tracing even when color overlap is high. Hollow-marker centerline traces use relaxed stroke-overlap thresholds only when marker-center alignment is also good.

panel_acceptance.pass: all curves pass and no pairwise review flags
panel_acceptance.warn: no curve fails, but at least one curve warns or at least one pair is overlap-flagged
panel_acceptance.fail: at least one curve fails stroke agreement or extent coverage
